## About
NWC Body Works Inc. is a full service truck, trailer and equipment facility in Elk Grove Village. We provide sales, service, repairs, fabrication and parts to the transportation industry, with a well trained staff and a fully equipped shop.
Our fabrication shop handles custom truck bodies and lift gate installations, and our collision center and paint shop cover everything from cabs and boxes to complete paint jobs. We want to get you back on the road quickly with a quality repair.
Customers rate us 4.7 on Google from 37 reviews. Call us or send a message, and one of our staff will get back to you.

## Services
- Fabrication and custom truck bodies: A full fabrication shop for custom truck body needs and lift gate installations.
- Collision center: A complete collision center for boxes, cabs, chassis and fiberglass.
- Lift gate parts and warranty work: We're a warranty facility with a large inventory of parts for all major lift gate manufacturers.
- Complete paint jobs: Tear down, prep and complete paint jobs with Imron Elite.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on weekends.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, NWC honors most credit cards.

Q: How do I reach you about a job?
A: Call us or fill out the contact form on our website. One of our qualified staff will respond as soon as possible.
